records.eligibility_summary: Twenty-five entering students, including first-year and transfer students, are chosen annually based on academic merit, extracurricular/community activity, and creativity. Chancellor's Scholarships require a minimum 31 ACT (1390 SAT) and 4.0 UT Core GPA.
records.award_amount_text: $5,000 per year for four years, or five years in standard five-year degree programs.
records.renewal_requirements: Cumulative GPA of 3.25 or higher, reviewed at the end of each spring; a written appeal for extenuating circumstances may grant probationary eligibility for the next semester.
records.deadline_text: Apply for admission by November 1 (first-year) and complete the scholarship questions; July 1 for transfers.
records.notes: Official page states amounts are for the 2026-27 academic year and programs are reviewed annually. Application/test-score windows on the same page refer to the current (Fall 2027 entry) cycle; 2027-28 amounts are not yet published.

records.eligibility_summary: Admitted in-state first-year students with a minimum 3.8 UT Weighted Core GPA who apply for admission by January 5 of the senior year; must matriculate the fall immediately after graduating from a US high school; US citizen or permanent resident.
records.test_requirement: ACT/SAT composite superscore tiers (writing not used); official scores received by May 15; only tests through December of the senior year count.
records.award_amount_text: $3,000-$9,000 per year for four years by test tier.
records.renewal_requirements: Maintain a 3.0 cumulative GPA, federal Satisfactory Academic Progress and full-time enrollment each semester.
records.deadline_text: Apply for admission by January 5; scores received by May 15.
records.notes: Cannot be combined with Orange & White. Official page states amounts are for the 2026-27 academic year and programs are reviewed annually. Application/test-score windows on the same page refer to the current (Fall 2027 entry) cycle; 2027-28 amounts are not yet published.

records.eligibility_summary: One top scholar from each of Tennessee's 95 counties; admitted in-state first-year students who apply by January 5 (November 1 priority) are automatically considered; minimum 3.2 UT core weighted GPA; holistic review.
records.award_amount_text: Tuition and mandatory fees, renewable for four years.
records.renewal_requirements: Maintain a 3.0 cumulative GPA, federal Satisfactory Academic Progress and full-time enrollment each semester.
records.deadline_text: November 1 priority; January 5 for automatic consideration.
records.notes: Combines with Pledge or HOPE but not with Volunteer, Orange & White, Provost or Flagship. records.eligibility_summary: In-state students who complete the five-year Next Chapter program, apply by January 5 of the senior year and enroll the following fall. records.award_amount_text: $1,500 per year, up to $6,000 over four years.
records.renewal_requirements: Maintain a 3.0 cumulative GPA, full-time enrollment throughout each semester, and Satisfactory Academic Progress.
records.notes: Retention criteria read verbatim from the 'How to Keep' section on 2026-10-02. records.eligibility_summary: Tennessee residents who receive HOPE, file the FAFSA by the UT Priority Filing Date and complete the UT Promise application by December 15; combined parent/student AGI under $75,000 and assets under $75,000.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident; U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
records.award_amount_text: Last-dollar award covering tuition and mandatory fees when combined with other federal, state and institutional aid.
records.renewal_requirements: Continuous full-time enrollment in CPOS-eligible courses, annual FAFSA by UT's priority date, continued HOPE eligibility, participation in the Rocky Top Scholars program, and eight volunteer service hours plus mentoring each semester.
records.deadline_text: UT Promise application by December 15; admission by January 5; FAFSA by UT Priority Filing Date.
records.notes: Need-based Tri-Star award (not merit). Official page states amounts are for the 2026-27 academic year and programs are reviewed annually. Application/test-score windows on the same page refer to the current (Fall 2027 entry) cycle; 2027-28 amounts are not yet published.

records.eligibility_summary: Tennessee high school graduates admitted as first-time freshmen (or transfers) with family AGI of $40,000 or less and total family assets of $40,000 or less; FAFSA by UT Priority Filing Date each year.
records.residency_requirement: Tennessee resident; U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
records.award_amount_text: Last-dollar award that, combined with other aid, covers tuition, mandatory fees and average on-campus housing and food, for up to eight semesters; college-specific course fees for architecture, business, engineering and nursing are not covered.
records.renewal_requirements: Continuous full-time enrollment in CPOS-eligible courses, annual FAFSA by UT's priority date, family household income of $60,000 or less, and participation in the Rocky Top Scholars program.
records.deadline_text: Admission by January 5; FAFSA by UT Priority Filing Date.
records.notes: Initial AGI limit $40,000; retention income limit $60,000, both as printed. Official page states amounts are for the 2026-27 academic year and programs are reviewed annually. Application/test-score windows on the same page refer to the current (Fall 2027 entry) cycle; 2027-28 amounts are not yet published.
